read_only_proof.event_scope: Complete observed browser request set after browser shutdown

limitations: The owned normal-TV fixture cannot prove standalone specials or all special-content combinations.
The VTT source response is 220 bytes on Goby versus the previously observed reference 195-byte normalization; both rendered the expected cue, and hashes remain distinct.
Auxiliary HTTP failures and page errors remain reported; they are not silently counted as supported operations.
Instance checks were continuous around the explicitly frozen runs; the independent logout proof is not atomically cancellable if an instance changes.
